rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for producing laughter or showing amusement.

example.english: I laugh as soon as I hear this joke.
example.traditional: 我一聽到呢個笑話就笑。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 teng1 dou2 ni1 go3 siu3 waa6 zau6 siu3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the sound or expression of laughter.

example.english: When they brought it up, we could hear everyone laugh throughout the house.
example.traditional: 佢一講起件事，我哋就聽到成屋都係笑聲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 gong2 hei2 gin6 si6 ngo5 dei6 zau6 teng1 dou2 seng4 uk1 dou1 hai6 siu3 sing1

rows.note: Use this construction when A is the person or thing being mocked or made fun of.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 siu3 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for a joke or something ridiculous that makes people laugh.

example.english: This joke really makes us laugh.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu3 waa6 zan1 hai6 gei2 hou2 siu3

rows.note: Use this for a person who brings fun and cheer to others, rather than for a joke or funny thing.

example.english: Ming is the fun one in our group and always makes us laugh.
example.traditional: 阿明係我哋班嘅開心果。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 baan1 ge3 hoi1 sam1 gwo2
